ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Home ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Home ENVIRONMENT.

   C. Guess results without recording observations on Home ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Home ENVIRONMENT.

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)

   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)

   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

16. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

17. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hand washing PRACTICES? (1 mark)

   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

21. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)
